title: Zetta ζ: An Efficient Closed-Loop Embodied Harness for Self-Evolving Physical Intelligence

key_results: 90.8% success on LIBERO-Pro, 93.6% on RoboCasa, 11.1x inference speedup

model_io.model: Code-based runtime critics and recovery skills

hypotheses.hypothesis: Closed-loop governance at action frequency improves robustness over open-loop fixed skills

task: PLC code generation with project-level verification
key_results: 72.6% mean verified pass rate on POUs; dynamic behavior score 52.2 vs 22.4-31.4 for baselines

hypotheses.hypothesis: Semantic grounding in task-relevant features differs from appearance consistency metrics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; outcome-achievement and generation-reliability are separable evaluation axes

key_results: Completes full workflow (raw data → manuscript) in all 36 cases; mean paper score 6.3; direct perception improves all 7 evaluation dimensions, wins 85% of head-to-head judgments

title: Co-RL: Unsupervised Reasoning Emerges from Diverse Cohort in Multi-agent RL
task: Label-free reasoning improvement via cooperative multi-agent RL
key_results: 3.0–8.6% gains on text benchmarks, 2.3–7.2% on multimodal; matches or exceeds supervised methods without ground-truth labels
comments: Multi-agent diversity elegantly mitigates self-reinforcement collapse, but gains depend on careful cohort design and remain incremental relative to supervised approaches.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Heterogeneous model families reduce correlated errors in peer-derived rewards
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; diversity consistently improves performance and maintains behavioral diversity

title: SPADE: Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments
task: Self-play environment design for continuous agent improvement

comments: Elegant two-role decomposition (Environment Designer and Reasoning Agent) elegantly targets the edge of capability, but regret estimation via privileged-hint gap assumes such hints are always available.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Learned environment design that targets regret edges outperforms fixed-environment baselines
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Environment Designer's accumulated memory and corpus grounding drive scaling

title: Training Chemical Plausibility-Aware Large Language Models for Single-Step Retrosynthesis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Top-K prompting with chemical plausibility rewards captures diverse reaction predictions better than single-answer metrics

hypotheses.hypothesis: Recurrent computation benefits compositional tool-use more than isolated API invocation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deformation-aware metrics reveal contact-quality issues missed by task-success-only evaluation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Managerial behavior, not scale/price, separates long-horizon performance

task: Scaling creative writing beyond story-centric data

hypotheses.hypothesis: Controlled genre expansion, beyond story scaling, improves robust creative writing

title: The More Popular, The Harder to Forget: Adaptive Popularity for LLM Unlearning

key_results: AdaPop leaks ~5x less content on paraphrased queries, ~1.6x less on adversarial; forget-set hidden states move further than competing methods

hypotheses.hypothesis: Popularity-dependent gradient pressure reduces leakage more than uniform pressure

title: Temporal Multi-Signal Fusion for Token-Level Hallucination Detection

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chromatin decompaction increases membrane tension via osmolyte-mediated osmolarity changes

title: Atomic structure and plasticity of the CTX-MthK complex investigated by cryo-EM, NMR, and MD simulations

key_results: Cryo-EM reveals overall CTX–MthK complex architecture; NMR shows anchoring lysine stably inserted into selectivity filter with fast-timescale dynamics at other contact sites; CTX alters ion configuration without rearranging the filter

hypotheses.hypothesis: CTX achieves high affinity and subtype tolerance through an anchored lysine with dynamic peripheral contacts
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: cryo-EM and NMR identify stably inserted lysine in selectivity filter; fast NMR dynamics reveal flexible peripheral interactions

hypotheses.hypothesis: CTX binding alters selectivity filter ion configuration without global filter rearrangement
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: NMR data show altered K⁺ configuration without filter structural changes

title: Dual downregulation of HRK and BAD promotes BCL-xL-mediated docetaxel resistance in prostate cancer

title: Shape-independent fluidity in epithelial cell monolayers

key_results: Reduced adhesion increased fluidity without changes in cell shape index, density, or traction; decoupling revealed dual role of adhesion in both adhesive energy and viscous drag

model_io.model: Confluent epithelial cell monolayers with reduced adhesion

hypotheses.hypothesis: Epithelial fluidity depends solely on cell shape and adhesion-tension balance
hypotheses.result: Partially refuted; adhesion also contributes kinetic viscous drag independent of shape

title: Krill oil attenuates skeletal muscle atrophy during D-galactose-induced accelerated aging via an AMPK-dependent mechanism
task: Identify AMPK-dependent mechanism by which krill oil attenuates D-galactose-induced skeletal muscle atrophy
key_results: Krill oil treatment prevented muscle mass loss, fiber atrophy, and senescence marker accumulation; AMPK genetic silencing abolished protective effects; molecular docking predicted KO component-AMPK interactions

model_io.model: Drosophila high salt diet model with tau transgene

title: Non-Markovianity induced by Pauli twirling
task: Non-Markovianity induced by Pauli twirling in quantum noise channels
key_results: Proved: (1) any Pauli channel with nonzero eigenvalues admits Pauli-Lindblad parameterization if complex parameters allowed; (2) Pauli channel fails channel-semigroup Markovianity iff ≥1 negative Pauli-Lindblad parameter; Pauli twirling can break Markovianity despite underlying Markovian divisibility (e.g., √X gate implementation)
comments: Rigorous mathematical characterization with direct implications for quantum error mitigation; negative/complex Pauli-Lindblad parameters necessary for physically accurate noise descriptions in gate implementations.
